summary: E2E frontend testing of iter63 Customer↔Contractor magic-link chat feature. Created a fresh gig (TEST_iter48_customer_chat / gig_eba244fffa75), assigned worker.demo, and exercised all 5 requested flows. All 5 flows PASS. Test gig deleted after run.

test_results.admin_flow: PASS — customer-chat-btn opens dialog; filling customer-thread-name + customer-thread-email and clicking customer-thread-create creates a new thread. customer-thread-row-{id} appears with link containing '/c/<token>' (production hostname hcobnetwork.com used by design). customer-thread-copy and customer-thread-close buttons visible. Status badge: 'active' (green).
test_results.customer_flow_public: PASS — /c/<token> renders without auth (verified via fresh browser context). HCOB Network header + Lightning icon present, 'ASSIGNMENT' subtitle present, gig title 'TEST_iter48_customer_chat' visible in customer-chat-gig-title. Composer + Send button present. Sent message appears as a blue (#0044FF) right-aligned bubble.
test_results.contractor_reply_flow: PASS — On /crew/assignments/<gigId>, worker-customer-chat-panel renders below the 'Message HCOB admin / Group chat' row. Thread is expandable via crew-customer-thread-toggle-{id}, composer crew-customer-composer-{id} and send button crew-customer-send-{id} work. Reply is sent and appears in the message list (worker bubble blue, customer bubble white).
test_results.privacy: PASS — Contractor thread card shows ONLY first name 'Jane'. NO email ('jane.test@example.com' absent), NO token ('ycmPdXb01' absent), NO full name ('Jane Test' absent). Customer chat page also shows only first name for crew chip.
test_results.close_flow: PASS — Admin clicked customer-thread-close-{id}, confirmed via window.confirm. Toast 'Chat closed' shown. Status badge flipped to 'closed' (gray). customer-thread-reopen-{id} button now visible. Public customer page picked up the close: customer-chat-closed-banner renders with text 'This chat has ended. Closed by admin', composer + send button are disabled (composer placeholder updates to 'This chat has ended.').

critical_code_review_comments: Console hydration warning observed (not new — pre-existing): 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Originates from FeedFilters.jsx select options in worker feed. Unrelated to iter63 but should be cleaned up.

Customer link returned from backend uses production hostname (https://hcobnetwork.com/c/<token>) — by design per the request note. Testing in preview required substituting REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Consider env-driven base URL so non-prod environments produce working copy-paste links.
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED test gig gig_eba244fffa75 (TEST_iter48_customer_chat). Worker assignment & customer thread (cthr_fa9a860fa17e, customer 'Jane Test') were transient on that gig and cleaned up with the gig delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter63 customer↔contractor magic-link chat is fully working end-to-end on the frontend. All data-testids in place. Only nit: customer_link is built with production hostname hcobnetwork.com — when testing in preview, substitute REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host + /c/<token>. Login route is /login (NOT /auth/login).
